map.RGB 是发光加色、色域广；CMYK 是油墨减色、色域窄，尤其亮蓝、荧光绿、纯品: RGB is an additive emissive model with a wide gamut, while CMYK is ink subtractive with a narrow gamut, so bright blues, fluorescent greens and pure magentas look darker and greyer in print. Vivid colours on screen often shift in print, so key colours should use Pantone spot colours or be confirmed by proofing.
